title: Zetta-Joule workforce strip
description: A white section with a featherlight heading left, paragraph and button right, then a strip of 4px-radius photos alternating tall and wide that bleeds off both edges and drifts sideways (about 16rem on desktop) as the section scrolls through.

CSS only; the drift is off under reduced motion
has `relative z-10` so it slides over a pinned section above it
